title: Linear encoded-size window universes and exact locality SAT in P
claims: WindowWeightBound bounds the total weight of overlapping fixed-size windows over an arbitrary sequence.
MeasuredLocalityUniverseBitBound gives a linear encoded-length bound for the exact measured signed-window clause catalogue, in addition to the row and membership bounds.
ExactWindowLocalitySAT proves exact P membership for the first-occurrence-locality SAT language using the signed-window universe in the measured elimination decision procedure.
